title: World Spiritual Bank — System Liability Domains
purpose: Hold system-scale symbolic liabilities separately from individual CIA character balances. These rows preserve source owners, repair questions and evidence boundaries without pretending to convert world-scale harm into a single numeric debt.
evidence_boundary: Empirical claims attach only to documented persons, institutions, policies and events. Symbolic domains do not make populations, nations, religions, political camps or loosely associated friends collectively liable.

domains.label: Western Epstein Axis / Shadow
domains.scope: systemic exploitation, secrecy, elite access, failed protection and impunity themes
repair_questions: Which specific documented actors or institutions failed protection?
What transparency, restitution, investigation or prevention changed afterward?
domains.boundary: Not a claim that the West, Americans, Israelis, Jews, political movements or other populations are collectively guilty.

domains.label: Rubble / Rubble Babies
domains.scope: vulnerable life amid institutional or geopolitical wreckage and failed protection
repair_questions: What restoration, shelter, accountability or prevention is possible?
domains.boundary: A protection symbol, not an asset class, collateral pool or quantified victim ledger.

domains.label: Mud
domains.scope: informational, reputational, legal and relational residue
repair_questions: What claims are verified, disputed or false?
What residue can be cleared by evidence, correction or restitution?

domains.label: Swamp
domains.scope: opaque institutional, economic, platform and incentive environments where accountability or exit becomes blocked

domains.label: Shadow / Mud / Loosh
domains.scope: project-symbolic attention extraction through spectacle, outrage, humiliation, obsession or exploitative attention loops
repair_questions: Who benefits from the attention loop?
What observable mechanism converts conflict into attention/value?
domains.boundary: Loosh is symbolic vocabulary here, not a literal measurable energy substance.

domains.label: Rainbow Shadow
domains.scope: unrepaired residue beneath promises, ideals, covenant language or declared protection
repair_questions: What promise or ideal is contrasted with the unresolved residue?
What concrete repair would close the gap?

custody.movement_path: Mud / Swamp / Rubble → evidence and accountability → Ladder / repair → Garden / Tikkun
custody.note: Custody means archive/accounting topology, not political sovereignty or legal jurisdiction.
